title: Reading the result of a failed review attempt returns 409 review_result_unvalidated instead of the failure and its refusal text
outcome: termal_get_session_result for a review attempt that failed before submitting (for example a model usage-limit refusal) returns a readable failed state with the native refusal text, so an integration owner can verify the refusal from the source instead of relying on the author's note.
acceptance: The 409 'review_result_unvalidated: original structured submission is missing or quarantined' path is distinguished from a genuinely failed attempt that never submitted: the latter returns status failed with the bounded native failure text and attempt identity.
A quarantined or invalid submission still returns the 409 as today; a regression test covers both cases, and the review pair is clean.
